steps.name: q-integer [k]_q := (q^k − q^{-k})/(q − q^{-1})
steps.operation: Define the balanced q-integer [k]_q := (q^k − q^{-k}) / (q − q^{-1}). The (q − q^{-1}) denominator is the per-crossing Hecke energy scale — the AXIOM entrypoint of every Hecke-side chain.

steps.name: q-hook-length dimension d_q(λ) for λ ⊢ 5
steps.operation: Apply the q-deformed hook-length formula d_q(λ) := [n]_q! / ∏_{x ∈ λ} [h_x]_q, with n = 5 and h_x the hook lengths of the Young diagram of λ. This is the Hecke-side quantum dimension of the Wedderburn block V_λ, defined for ALL rows (no ≤2-row truncation).

steps.name: Total quantum dimension D
steps.operation: Sum the squared block dimensions over the seven blocks λ ⊢ 5 and take the positive square root: D := sqrt(Σ_{λ ⊢ 5} d_q(λ)²). Pure algebra on the previous step; the Wedderburn decomposition supplies the block set.
steps.notes: D ≠ 0 because every d_q(λ) > 0 for real q > 1 (sum of positive squares); the positivity is the corpus lemma sum_qDimSq_pos.

steps.name: Vacuum S-matrix row S_{0λ} = d_q(λ)/D
steps.operation: Form the normalised quantum-dimension vector S_{0λ} := d_q(λ)/D. In any modular tensor category the vacuum row of the S-matrix is exactly the quantum dimension divided by the total dimension; here it is the Hecke-side realisation of that structural identity. The Verlinde measure is its square, μ(λ) = S_{0λ}², and Σ_λ S_{0λ}² = 1 follows by construction from the definition of D.
steps.notes: Sorry-free in Lean: verlindeMeasure_eq_plancherel proves μ(λ) = S_{0λ}² = d_q(λ)²/Σ d_q², i.e. the localization measure IS the Hecke Plancherel measure, from the published modular-data identity alone.

steps.name: Ribbon twist θ_λ = q^{2c(λ)} from the content sum
steps.operation: Define the content sum c(λ) := Σ_{(i,j) ∈ λ} (j − i) over the cells of λ, and the ribbon twist eigenvalue θ_λ := q^{2c(λ)}. This is the T-matrix companion of the S-row: exact representation theory, not a choice. Conjugation acts antisymmetrically, c(λ') = −c(λ), hence θ_{λ'} = θ_λ^{-1}.
steps.notes: Sorry-free in Lean (KeystoneModularTwist): theta_conjugate proves θ_{λ'} = θ_λ^{-1} from contentSum_conjugate, the conjugation-antisymmetry of the content sum.

steps.name: Cross-route agreement with the WRT / Lawrence–Rozansky McKay value map
steps.operation: Compare the Hecke-side modular data just derived against the independent WRT / Lawrence–Rozansky route at the substrate anchor: (i) the McKay/Chebyshev amplitude value map d^{WRT}(λ) in the fold variable t = q + q^{-1} against d_q(λ), so the vacuum S-rows coincide block-by-block; (ii) the sl-Casimir ribbon exponent κ_λ = Σ_i λ_i(λ_i − 2i + 1) against the content-sum exponent 2c(λ); (iii) the conjugation antisymmetry θ_λ·θ_{λ'} = 1 on both expressions; (iv) Verlinde unitarity Σ_λ S_{0λ}² = 1. All four hold to 40 dps.
